newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plains fed cattle bid $65, passed -feedlots.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plains fed cattle bid $65, passed -feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle bids early Thursday at $65.00 per cwt were passed by owners pricing cattle at $67.00, feedlot sources said.

"Everybody's waiting to see if (CME live cattle) futures will show some follow-through strength today. If they do, then there's an 80 percent chance we'll see $66.00," a Texas Panhandle feedlot manager said.
Fed cattle on Wednesday sold at $65.00 in light volume, but further bids at that level were resisted when futures rallied, several feedlot managers said.
Last week's top was $67.00, with late sales at $66.00.
